description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over time for the SepLLM method, with the x-axis representing training time in seconds (ranging from 0 to 250,000) and the y-axis showing the loss value (ranging from 2.40 to 2.75). Two lines are plotted: a purple line with triangle markers and a red line with circle markers, both showing a decreasing trend in loss as training time increases. The purple line starts at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0 seconds and gradually decreases to around 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The red line starts at a slightly lower loss of about 2.70 and also decreases, reaching approximately 2.48 by 250,000 seconds. A green dashed horizontal line at a loss of 2.50 is shown, with a vertical green dashed line at 200,000 seconds indicating the point where the red line crosses this threshold. A green bracket highlights the difference between the two lines at 200,000 seconds, labeled as "1.26×", suggesting a performance comparison or speedup factor. The legend identifies the red line as representing the SepLLM method.
